input.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `float64`, `float32`, `half`, `complex64`, `complex128`. A tensor of shape `[..., M, N]` whose inner-most 2 dimensions form matrices of size `[M, N]`. Let `P` be the minimum of `M` and `N`.
constraints: input must be one of float64, float32, half, complex64, complex128, P, M, N

full_matrices.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. If true, compute full-sized `q` and `r`. If false (the default), compute only the leading `P` columns of `q`.

output.description: A tuple of `Tensor` objects (q, r). A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`. r: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`.
